title: Bencana Besar
text: Wah, ini memang dah melampau. Macam tak pernah dengar pasal Malaysia pun. Mungkin sejarah bukan untuk kau… atau apa-apa pun sebenarnya.

title: Total Disaster
text: Wow, this is beyond bad. It’s like you’ve never heard of Malaysia before. Maybe history isn’t your thing… or anything, really.

title: Memalukan Negara
text: Tidur masa kelas sejarah ke? Jawapan ni terlalu teruk, sampai rasa macam tak sayang negara. Cuba lagi, atau pindah je la.

title: National Embarrassment
text: Did you sleep through history class? This answer is so bad, it’s practically unpatriotic. Try again, or consider relocating.

title: Patriot Setengah Masak
text: Kau macam tahu, tapi tak tahu sangat. Macam kibarkan bendera dengan malas—sedih je tengok. Kaji balik sejarah kau, kawan.

title: Half-Baked Patriot
text: You’re kind of there, but mostly not. It’s like waving a flag with no enthusiasm—just sad. Brush up on your history, champ.

title: Rakyat Malaysia Biasa-Biasa
text: Kau tahu cukup untuk tak memalukan diri sepenuhnya, tapi jujurnya—kau takkan menang anugerah 'Patriot Sejati' dengan jawapan ni.

title: Mediocre Malaysian
text: You know just enough to not be completely embarrassing, but let’s be honest—you’re not winning any 'True Patriot' awards with this.

title: Hampir Anak Malaysia
text: Kau hampir jadi juara, tapi belum cukup lagi. Semangat ada, tapi nampak macam kau baca sinopsis sejarah je. Lain kali, fokus betul-betul!

title: Almost Anak Malaysia
text: You’re close, but not close enough. You’ve got the spirit, but it seems like you skimmed the textbook. Go all in next time!

title: Merdeka Mastermind
text: Wah, nampaknya kau ensiklopedia berjalan tentang Malaysia! Macam kau ada kat sana masa 1957 dulu. Jangan terlalu bangga sangat pulak.

title: Merdeka Mastermind
text: Well, well, well, look who’s a walking encyclopedia of Malaysia! It’s almost like you were there in 1957. Don’t let it go to your head.
